summary: Before any code: who has the problem, the job, the pain and the non-goals. You write three requirements that each say one thing and carry a check, one success criterion with numbers, and the real numbers of where your project is today, measured with two new scripts (retrieval latency by stage, and a customer leak check).

items.text: Write docs/problem.md with who, job, pain and at least two non-goals
Write three requirements, each with its check, and rewrite any vague one
Run run_golden.py, measure_latency.py and leak_check.py and write down the numbers
Write one success criterion with numbers and a line 'Today: ...'
Say which gap you would close first, and why
Play the Testable Requirement game to the end and see your score
